title: alseodaphne excelsa
intro: Alseodaphne excelsa, commonly known as Agarwood tree or 'Agaru', is a plant species in the family Lauraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Alseodaphne excelsa include its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and promote digestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, phenolics, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
